profile_text.body:
# Krita Foundation

Krita Foundation is an open-source foundation that develops Krita, a digital art application. According to its website, Krita is designed for painting, illustration, comics, and concept art creation.

Krita Foundation offers Krita AI, an image and graphic design product that integrates local AI plugins into the open-source digital art platform. The product operates without cloud dependency and is governed by the community. The foundation is a non-profit organization.
